grammar_errors.mistake: Talking about his fiancée he used the masculine adjective; Amal recast it feminine with a question.
Same masculine adjective again after her 02:00 fix; she recast عيانة again and he repeated 'Yeah, عيانة' - its own slip per the brief.
He put the verb before the thing that hurts; Amal recast with راسها before بيوجع (the brief's own example); 04:07 is a repeat.
قلقان takes من; he used لـ and Amal said 'Men not' and explained 'worried from', he then said من نار.
grammar_errors.fix: Men not. ... You're worried about. You're worried from.

grammar_errors.mistake: دير بال takes على; he went straight from بال to خطيبتي and Amal recast with على (she said it outright at 11:45).
Missing على again after her 09:51 fix; Amal named it: 'بدير بالي takes على'.
باليك is not a form; the 'your' ending on بال is بالك, which Amal gave (and noted it is the command).
grammar_errors.fix: دير بالك is actually the command form.

grammar_errors.mistake: After خلينا a bare present verb follows; he used past عملنا and Amal recast نعمل, he repeated it.
Amal asked 'one?' to his غيم and he gave the plural غيوم (the engine wrote فئة واحدة for her 'one?').
She asked what is there OTHER than sun and day; he dropped غير and said الشمس with el-. Amal recast غير شمس و يوم, he asked 'غير الشمس?' and she repeated غير شمس (8eir + bare noun).

Fronted نجمة needs a pointer ending on the verb; Amal named the pointer rule and he said بشوفها.

The object (the floor) must ride on the verb; Amal prompted 'It.' and he said نظفتها.

He meant the old streets (plural, قديمة); Amal recast الشوارع.

grammar_errors.fix: Or just حجر. Are stone. ... Made of is different than made.
